The question asks which line represents precision. From the caption, we know that the figure shows F-1 measure for hyperonymization of orders 1 ≤ N ≤ 12, and there are three classes: GSPO and GDIP. The lines in the graph are labeled as "Rec." (red), "Prec." (blue), and "F-mass" (black). 

Looking at the graph, the red line is labeled "Rec.", the blue line is labeled "Prec.", and the black line is labeled "F-mass". Therefore, the blue line represents precision.
